title: bloomy scraped
description: This project add new armor sets, and next armor upgrade after netherite. Now there's new drop from pillagers and ravegers! If you'll be lucky you can get a new thunderstorm chestplate, or you will find a new lunar armor that change your gravity!
body: This mod add deleted and cancelled content from minecraft custom server bloomy. You can upgrade your netherite armor, craft new knife and pass raids for new exclusive drop.If you'll be lucky, you find new artifacts in fishing and archeology. FINALLY armor for fly and horn of pillagers in our mod!!!!! Download right now
